info.name: Generate a response from the LinqAlpha engine via SSE

items.docs:
Generate a response from the LinqAlpha engine. LinqAlpha uses different types of language models and data sources to generate an answer. The response is provided as a server-sent events (SSE) stream.

**Note**: For this search chat endpoint, the stock_id (BBG_ID) can be obtained by referring to the [Map Tickers API](https://docs.linqalpha.com/api-reference/basic/map_tickers) and using the `stock_id` value from its response.

info.name: Generate an analytics response via SSE

items.docs:
Generate an agentic analytics response via Server-Sent Events. This endpoint leverages multi-step reasoning with tool use to deliver deeper, more comprehensive answers compared to the standard search & generate endpoints.

The response stream includes message echo, thinking processes, tool calls with results, and the final answer.
